coder_notes: The registered intervention type is Radiation, but it is a radiolabelled peptide (radiopharmaceutical) and is coded as a pharmacological candidate. Ligand name without isotope used for active_moiety (W1). Protocol text also mentions [68Ga]Ga-PSMA PET/CT for biopsy site, free 68Ga catheter patency imaging, and pre-dose mannitol/saline/dexamethasone (purpose not stated); these are not registered interventions and are not listed (R9). Tumour PK coded yes from quantitative SPECT/CT of tumour/cavity accumulation (imaging-based, not tissue sampling); adjudicator may review. Catheter, Rickham reservoir and saline infusion pump are used for local delivery (new_route); device_dependent set false because no device activation is described. Primary outcome in registry is clinical progression while the description states overall survival.
